tool_input.content:
name: RIA_PORTFOLIO_ANALYTICS
description: >
  RIA Portfolio Analytics semantic view for wealth management.
  Covers client demographics and segmentation, advisor book of business,
  investment account details, security reference data, portfolio performance
  returns with benchmark comparison, and current account valuations including
  holdings and model allocations.
  Designed for RIA compliance, client reporting, and advisor productivity analysis.

tables:
  - name: dim_client
    base_table:
      database: KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY
      schema: GOLD
      table: DIM_CLIENT
    description: >
      Client dimension. One row per client household or individual with demographics,
      wealth segmentation, contact information, risk profile, and primary advisor linkage.
    primary_key:
      columns:
        - client_id
    dimensions:
      - name: client_id
        expr: CLIENT_ID
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique client identifier from Salesforce FSC
        unique: true
      - name: client_name
        expr: CLIENT_NAME
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Full name of the client
      - name: first_name
        expr: FIRST_NAME
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Client first name
      - name: last_name
        expr: LAST_NAME
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Client last name
      - name: email
        expr: EMAIL
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Client email address
      - name: phone
        expr: PHONE
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Client phone number
      - name: state
        expr: STATE
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Client state of residence
      - name: city
        expr: CITY
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Client city of residence
      - name: zip
        expr: ZIP
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Client zip code
      - name: account_type
        expr: ACCOUNT_TYPE
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account entity type such as Individual, Household, Joint, Trust, or Business
      - name: client_segment
        expr: CLIENT_SEGMENT
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Wealth segmentation tier such as HNW, UHNW, Mass Affluent, or Institutional
      - name: service_model
        expr: SERVICE_MODEL
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Service delivery tier assigned to the client
      - name: risk_tolerance
        expr: RISK_TOLERANCE
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Client risk tolerance profile such as Conservative, Moderate, or Aggressive
      - name: investment_experience
        expr: INVESTMENT_EXPERIENCE
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Client investment knowledge level
      - name: date_of_birth
        expr: DATE_OF_BIRTH
        data_type: DATE
        description: Client date of birth
      - name: employment_status
        expr: EMPLOYMENT_STATUS
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Client employment status
      - name: occupation
        expr: OCCUPATION
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Client occupation
      - name: relationship_start_date
        expr: RELATIONSHIP_START_DATE
        data_type: DATE
        description: Date the advisory relationship began
    measures:
      - name: total_clients
        expr: CLIENT_ID
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Count of distinct clients
        default_aggregation: count_distinct
      - name: client_total_aum
        expr: TOTAL_AUM
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Total assets under management across all of the client accounts
        default_aggregation: sum
      - name: client_account_count
        expr: ACCOUNT_COUNT
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Number of financial accounts per client
        default_aggregation: sum

  - name: dim_advisor
    base_table:
      database: KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY
      schema: GOLD
      table: DIM_ADVISOR
    description: >
      Advisor dimension. One row per financial advisor with role, team assignment,
      region, credentials, and aggregate book metrics including client count and total AUM.
    primary_key:
      columns:
        - advisor_id
    dimensions:
      - name: advisor_id
        expr: ADVISOR_ID
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique advisor identifier from Salesforce FSC
        unique: true
      - name: advisor_name
        expr: ADVISOR_NAME
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Full name of the financial advisor
      - name: advisor_email
        expr: EMAIL
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advisor email address
      - name: advisor_role
        expr: ROLE
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advisor role such as Lead Advisor or Senior Advisor
      - name: crd_number
        expr: CRD_NUMBER
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: FINRA Central Registration Depository number
      - name: rep_code
        expr: REP_CODE
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advisor rep code used across custodian platforms
      - name: branch
        expr: BRANCH
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Office branch name
      - name: advisor_is_active
        expr: IS_ACTIVE
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Whether the advisor is currently active
      - name: hire_date
        expr: HIRE_DATE
        data_type: DATE
        description: Advisor hire date
      - name: termination_date
        expr: TERMINATION_DATE
        data_type: DATE
        description: Advisor termination date or NULL if active
      - name: team_name
        expr: TEAM_NAME
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Name of the advisory team
      - name: region
        expr: REGION
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Geographic region of the advisory team
    measures:
      - name: total_advisors
        expr: ADVISOR_ID
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Count of distinct advisors
        default_aggregation: count_distinct
      - name: advisor_client_count
        expr: CLIENT_COUNT
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Number of active clients managed by the advisor
        default_aggregation: sum
      - name: advisor_total_aum
        expr: TOTAL_AUM
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Total assets under management across the advisor book of business
        default_aggregation: sum

  - name: dim_account
    base_table:
      database: KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY
      schema: GOLD
      table: DIM_ACCOUNT
    description: >
      Account dimension. One row per financial account with registration type,
      custodian, model portfolio assignment, fee schedule, and status.
    primary_key:
      columns:
        - financial_account_id
    dimensions:
      - name: financial_account_id
        expr: FINANCIAL_ACCOUNT_ID
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique financial account identifier
        unique: true
      - name: account_number
        expr: ACCOUNT_NUMBER
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Custodian-assigned account number
      - name: account_name
        expr: ACCOUNT_NAME
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Display name of the account
      - name: registration_type
        expr: REGISTRATION_TYPE
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Legal registration type such as Individual, Joint, Trust, or Custodial
      - name: dim_account_type
        expr: ACCOUNT_TYPE
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account type such as Brokerage, IRA, 401k, Trust
      - name: account_status
        expr: STATUS
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Current account status such as Open or Closed
      - name: custodian_code
        expr: CUSTODIAN_CODE
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Custodian platform code such as SCHW, PERS, or FIDL
      - name: inception_date
        expr: INCEPTION_DATE
        data_type: DATE
        description: Date the account was opened
      - name: fee_schedule
        expr: FEE_SCHEDULE
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Fee schedule tier such as Standard, Premium, or Custom
      - name: model_id
        expr: MODEL_ID
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Assigned model portfolio identifier
      - name: account_is_discretionary
        expr: IS_DISCRETIONARY
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Whether the account has discretionary management authority
    measures:
      - name: total_accounts
        expr: FINANCIAL_ACCOUNT_ID
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Count of distinct financial accounts
        default_aggregation: count_distinct
      - name: fee_rate
        expr: FEE_RATE
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Management fee rate as a decimal
        default_aggregation: avg

  - name: dim_security
    base_table:
      database: KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY
      schema: GOLD
      table: DIM_SECURITY
    description: >
      Security dimension. One row per traded security with ticker, CUSIP, ISIN,
      asset classification, exchange, issuer, expense ratio, and ESG flag.
    primary_key:
      columns:
        - ticker
    dimensions:
      - name: ticker
        expr: TICKER
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Ticker symbol
        unique: true
      - name: cusip
        expr: CUSIP
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: CUSIP identifier
      - name: isin
        expr: ISIN
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: ISIN identifier
      - name: security_name
        expr: SECURITY_NAME
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Display name of the security
      - name: asset_class
        expr: ASSET_CLASS
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Asset class such as US Equity, Fixed Income, Alternatives, Cash
      - name: sub_asset_class
        expr: SUB_ASSET_CLASS
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Sub-asset class such as Large Cap Growth, Broad Market, Sector
      - name: sector
        expr: SECTOR
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Market sector such as Technology, Healthcare, Financials
      - name: security_type
        expr: SECURITY_TYPE
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Instrument type such as Equity, ETF, or Cash
      - name: exchange
        expr: EXCHANGE
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary exchange such as NYSE, NASDAQ, NYSE Arca
      - name: issuer
        expr: ISSUER
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Security issuer or fund manager
      - name: country
        expr: COUNTRY
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Country of domicile
      - name: security_is_esg
        expr: IS_ESG
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Whether the security is ESG-screened
      - name: risk_rating
        expr: RISK_RATING
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Risk rating from 1 (low) to 5 (high)
    measures:
      - name: total_securities
        expr: TICKER
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Count of distinct securities
        default_aggregation: count_distinct
      - name: expense_ratio
        expr: EXPENSE_RATIO
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: Annual expense ratio for ETFs and funds
        default_aggregation: avg
      - name: dividend_yield
        expr: DIVIDEND_YIELD
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: Current dividend yield
        default_aggregation: avg

  - name: fct_account_value
    base_table:
      database: KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY
      schema: GOLD
      table: FCT_ACCOUNT_VALUE
    description: >
      Account value fact. Current snapshot per financial account with market value,
      model portfolio allocation targets, latest period returns and benchmark comparison,
      and aggregated holdings summary including cost basis and unrealized gain/loss.
    primary_key:
      columns:
        - financial_account_id
    dimensions:
      - name: fct_financial_account_id
        expr: FINANCIAL_ACCOUNT_ID
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Financial account identifier foreign key
      - name: fct_account_number
        expr: ACCOUNT_NUMBER
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Custodian-assigned account number
      - name: fct_client_id
        expr: CLIENT_ID
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Client identifier foreign key
      - name: fct_advisor_id
        expr: ADVISOR_ID
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advisor identifier foreign key
      - name: fct_model_id
        expr: MODEL_ID
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Model portfolio identifier
      - name: model_name
        expr: MODEL_NAME
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Display name of the assigned model portfolio
      - name: risk_profile
        expr: RISK_PROFILE
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Model risk profile such as Conservative, Moderate, Growth, or Aggressive
      - name: fct_is_discretionary
        expr: IS_DISCRETIONARY
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Whether the account has discretionary authority
      - name: benchmark_name
        expr: BENCHMARK_NAME
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Name of the benchmark used for performance comparison
      - name: return_as_of_date
        expr: RETURN_AS_OF_DATE
        data_type: DATE
        description: Date of the most recent return calculation
      - name: positions_as_of_date
        expr: POSITIONS_AS_OF_DATE
        data_type: DATE
        description: Date of the most recent position snapshot
    measures:
      - name: market_value
        expr: MARKET_VALUE
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Total market value of the account
        default_aggregation: sum
      - name: avg_market_value
        expr: MARKET_VALUE
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Average market value per account
        default_aggregation: avg
      - name: equity_target_pct
        expr: EQUITY_TARGET_PCT
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Model target equity allocation percentage
        default_aggregation: avg
      - name: fixed_income_target_pct
        expr: FIXED_INCOME_TARGET_PCT
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Model target fixed income allocation percentage
        default_aggregation: avg
      - name: alternative_target_pct
        expr: ALTERNATIVE_TARGET_PCT
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Model target alternative allocation percentage
        default_aggregation: avg
      - name: cash_target_pct
        expr: CASH_TARGET_PCT
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Model target cash allocation percentage
        default_aggregation: avg
      - name: mtd_return
        expr: MTD_RETURN
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Month-to-date portfolio return
        default_aggregation: avg
      - name: qtd_return
        expr: QTD_RETURN
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Quarter-to-date portfolio return
        default_aggregation: avg
      - name: ytd_return
        expr: YTD_RETURN
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Year-to-date portfolio return
        default_aggregation: avg
      - name: one_year_return
        expr: ONE_YEAR_RETURN
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Trailing 1-year portfolio return
        default_aggregation: avg
      - name: three_year_return
        expr: THREE_YEAR_RETURN
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Trailing 3-year annualized portfolio return
        default_aggregation: avg
      - name: five_year_return
        expr: FIVE_YEAR_RETURN
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Trailing 5-year annualized portfolio return
        default_aggregation: avg
      - name: mtd_excess_return
        expr: MTD_EXCESS_RETURN
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Month-to-date return minus benchmark return
        default_aggregation: avg
      - name: ytd_excess_return
        expr: YTD_EXCESS_RETURN
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Year-to-date return minus benchmark return
        default_aggregation: avg
      - name: one_year_excess_return
        expr: ONE_YEAR_EXCESS_RETURN
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Trailing 1-year return minus benchmark return
        default_aggregation: avg
      - name: holding_count
        expr: HOLDING_COUNT
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Number of distinct securities held in the account
        default_aggregation: sum
      - name: holdings_market_value
        expr: HOLDINGS_MARKET_VALUE
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Sum of all position market values
        default_aggregation: sum
      - name: holdings_cost_basis
        expr: HOLDINGS_COST_BASIS
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Sum of all position cost basis values
        default_aggregation: sum
      - name: total_unrealized_gain_loss
        expr: TOTAL_UNREALIZED_GAIN_LOSS
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Sum of unrealized gain or loss across all positions
        default_aggregation: sum

  - name: fct_portfolio_return
    base_table:
      database: KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY
      schema: GOLD
      table: FCT_PORTFOLIO_RETURN
    description: >
      Portfolio return fact. One row per account per month with portfolio returns
      at multiple horizons, benchmark comparison, and excess returns. Use this table
      for time-series analysis of portfolio performance.
    primary_key:
      columns:
        - return_key
    dimensions:
      - name: ret_account_number
        expr: ACCOUNT_NUMBER
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account number foreign key for joining to dim_account
      - name: as_of_date
        expr: AS_OF_DATE
        data_type: DATE
        description: Return period end date, typically month-end
      - name: ret_client_id
        expr: CLIENT_ID
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Client identifier foreign key
      - name: ret_advisor_id
        expr: ADVISOR_ID
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advisor identifier foreign key
      - name: ret_benchmark_name
        expr: BENCHMARK_NAME
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Benchmark used for this return period
      - name: return_method
        expr: RETURN_METHOD
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Return calculation methodology such as TWR or IRR
      - name: ret_client_segment
        expr: CLIENT_SEGMENT
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Client wealth segment at the time of the return
    measures:
      - name: ret_mtd_return
        expr: MTD_RETURN
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Month-to-date portfolio return
        default_aggregation: avg
      - name: ret_qtd_return
        expr: QTD_RETURN
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Quarter-to-date portfolio return
        default_aggregation: avg
      - name: ret_ytd_return
        expr: YTD_RETURN
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Year-to-date portfolio return
        default_aggregation: avg
      - name: ret_itd_return
        expr: ITD_RETURN
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Inception-to-date portfolio return
        default_aggregation: avg
      - name: ret_one_year_return
        expr: ONE_YEAR_RETURN
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Trailing 1-year portfolio return
        default_aggregation: avg
      - name: ret_three_year_return
        expr: THREE_YEAR_RETURN
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Trailing 3-year annualized portfolio return
        default_aggregation: avg
      - name: ret_five_year_return
        expr: FIVE_YEAR_RETURN
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Trailing 5-year annualized portfolio return
        default_aggregation: avg
      - name: ret_benchmark_mtd_return
        expr: BENCHMARK_MTD_RETURN
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Benchmark month-to-date return
        default_aggregation: avg
      - name: ret_benchmark_ytd_return
        expr: BENCHMARK_YTD_RETURN
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Benchmark year-to-date return
        default_aggregation: avg
      - name: ret_benchmark_one_year_return
        expr: BENCHMARK_ONE_YEAR_RETURN
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Benchmark trailing 1-year return
        default_aggregation: avg
      - name: ret_mtd_excess_return
        expr: MTD_EXCESS_RETURN
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Month-to-date alpha vs benchmark
        default_aggregation: avg
      - name: ret_ytd_excess_return
        expr: YTD_EXCESS_RETURN
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Year-to-date alpha vs benchmark
        default_aggregation: avg
      - name: ret_one_year_excess_return
        expr: ONE_YEAR_EXCESS_RETURN
        data_type: NUMBER
        description: Trailing 1-year alpha vs benchmark
        default_aggregation: avg

relationships:
  - name: fct_account_value_to_dim_client
    left_table: fct_account_value
    right_table: dim_client
    relationship_columns:
      - left_column: fct_client_id
        right_column: client_id
    join_type: left_outer
    relationship_type: many_to_one
  - name: fct_account_value_to_dim_advisor
    left_table: fct_account_value
    right_table: dim_advisor
    relationship_columns:
      - left_column: fct_advisor_id
        right_column: advisor_id
    join_type: left_outer
    relationship_type: many_to_one
  - name: fct_account_value_to_dim_account
    left_table: fct_account_value
    right_table: dim_account
    relationship_columns:
      - left_column: fct_financial_account_id
        right_column: financial_account_id
    join_type: left_outer
    relationship_type: many_to_one
  - name: fct_portfolio_return_to_dim_account
    left_table: fct_portfolio_return
    right_table: dim_account
    relationship_columns:
      - left_column: ret_account_number
        right_column: account_number
    join_type: left_outer
    relationship_type: many_to_one
  - name: fct_portfolio_return_to_dim_client
    left_table: fct_portfolio_return
    right_table: dim_client
    relationship_columns:
      - left_column: ret_client_id
        right_column: client_id
    join_type: left_outer
    relationship_type: many_to_one
  - name: fct_portfolio_return_to_dim_advisor
    left_table: fct_portfolio_return
    right_table: dim_advisor
    relationship_columns:
      - left_column: ret_advisor_id
        right_column: advisor_id
    join_type: left_outer
    relationship_type: many_to_one
  - name: dim_client_to_dim_advisor
    left_table: dim_client
    right_table: dim_advisor
    relationship_columns:
      - left_column: advisor_id
        right_column: advisor_id
    join_type: left_outer
    relationship_type: many_to_one

verified_queries:
  - name: top_clients_by_aum
    question: Who are the top 10 clients by market value?
    sql: |
      SELECT c.client_name, c.client_segment, f.market_value, f.ytd_return, f.model_name
      FROM KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.GOLD.FCT_ACCOUNT_VALUE f
      JOIN KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.GOLD.DIM_CLIENT c ON c.client_id = f.client_id
      ORDER BY f.market_value DESC NULLS LAST
      LIMIT 10
    verified_at: 1727600000
    verified_by: keith.evans@atrium.ai
  - name: advisors_ranked_by_aum
    question: Show all advisors ranked by total AUM
    sql: |
      SELECT advisor_name, team_name, region, client_count, total_aum
      FROM KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.GOLD.DIM_ADVISOR
      ORDER BY total_aum DESC
    verified_at: 1727600000
    verified_by: keith.evans@atrium.ai
  - name: aum_by_client_segment
    question: What is the total AUM and average YTD return by client segment?
    sql: |
      SELECT c.client_segment,
             COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count,
             SUM(f.market_value) AS total_aum,
             AVG(f.ytd_return) AS avg_ytd_return
      FROM KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.GOLD.FCT_ACCOUNT_VALUE f
      JOIN KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.GOLD.DIM_CLIENT c ON c.client_id = f.client_id
      GROUP BY c.client_segment
      ORDER BY total_aum DESC
    verified_at: 1727600000
    verified_by: keith.evans@atrium.ai
  - name: monthly_return_vs_benchmark
    question: Show me the monthly average portfolio return vs benchmark over time
    sql: |
      SELECT r.as_of_date,
             AVG(r.mtd_return) AS avg_mtd_return,
             AVG(r.benchmark_mtd_return) AS avg_benchmark_return,
             AVG(r.mtd_excess_return) AS avg_excess_return
      FROM KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.GOLD.FCT_PORTFOLIO_RETURN r
      GROUP BY r.as_of_date
      ORDER BY r.as_of_date
    verified_at: 1727600000
    verified_by: keith.evans@atrium.ai
  - name: performance_by_risk_profile
    question: How are accounts performing by risk profile?
    sql: |
      SELECT f.risk_profile,
             COUNT(*) AS account_count,
             AVG(f.market_value) AS avg_market_value,
             AVG(f.ytd_return) AS avg_ytd_return,
             AVG(f.ytd_excess_return) AS avg_excess
      FROM KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.GOLD.FCT_ACCOUNT_VALUE f
      GROUP BY f.risk_profile
      ORDER BY avg_market_value DESC
    verified_at: 1727600000
    verified_by: keith.evans@atrium.ai
  - name: worst_ytd_accounts
    question: Which accounts have the worst YTD performance?
    sql: |
      SELECT a.account_name, a.registration_type, a.custodian_code,
             f.market_value, f.ytd_return, f.holding_count
      FROM KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.GOLD.FCT_ACCOUNT_VALUE f
      JOIN KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.GOLD.DIM_ACCOUNT a ON a.financial_account_id = f.financial_account_id
      WHERE f.ytd_return < 0
      ORDER BY f.ytd_return ASC
      LIMIT 20
    verified_at: 1727600000
    verified_by: keith.evans@atrium.ai
